name: gemfinder
title: gemfinder · narrative gems, crypto + stocks
description: Scans keyless public feeds (CoinGecko trending + category momentum, DexScreener boosts and new tokens, reddit mentions via ApeWisdom, Yahoo Finance trending and small-cap/day-gainer screens, Hacker News buzz) for crypto tokens and stocks a hot narrative is starting to carry. Merges per ticker, heats 13 narratives, and ranks candidates by an attention score (attention, velocity, narrative, momentum, size) with reasons and risk flags. Type anything ("quantum", "frog", "nuclear drones") and it becomes a live theme: matched against every candidate, plus CoinGecko/DexScreener/Yahoo search. Scans are cached 10 min in-process and warmed in the background so the app opens instantly. Stdlib-only, one SQLite cache. Attention, not a forecast.
state: ~/.mod/gemfinder/cache.db (raw HTTP bodies by url) · ~/.mod/gemfinder/scans.jsonl (every scan's picks + price) · in-process scan cache (SCAN_TTL 600s, GEMFINDER_SCAN_TTL to change; GEMFINDER_WARM=0 disables the warmer)
